_note: exports-switch-off-after-repeated-failure. ExportJobService::recordRun counts a job's failed runs in a row and switches the job off at the threshold (app config export_failure_threshold, 1 to 10, default 3), recording why and when. enableJob clears all three. Version 1.2.0 adds optional fields only.

consecutiveFailures.title: Failed runs in a row
consecutiveFailures.description: How many runs in a row have failed. A succeeded run sets it back to 0.

pausedReason.title: Switched off because
pausedReason.description: Why the job was switched off automatically; empty while it was not.

pausedAt.title: Switched off at
pausedAt.description: When the job was switched off automatically.
